title: Composer preferences
description: The Composer's settings (docs/preferences.md); every member is optional and its default is the value the Composer used before the document existed. An unknown member is refused with its path.

melody.description: The settings of the melody stage (docs/preferences.md).

second_nearest_chord_tone.description: n/d with 0 <= n <= d and d from 1 to 16.

weights.description: The weight each group of soft rules counts in a melody's score.

closure.description: How many times the closure rules count for the theme's last cadence (final) and for an earlier one (first). 0 leaves them out.

rhythm_repeat_bars.description: The most bars in a row of 2 or more notes that may share one rhythm. 0 sets no limit.

leaps.description: How many times a melody's leaps count against it. 0 leaves them out.

register.description: How many times an idea's drift from the register of the span before it counts against it. 0 leaves it out.

cadence_long.description: The idea that ends a cadence ends on one note held from its last downbeat to its end, on the cadence's tone (R-712). Off by default.

color_note.description: In a modal key, how likely a strong or long melody note is to take one of the mode's characteristic steps when its chord has one: color_note draws in color_note + 1 take it (R-732). 0 never; major and minor keys have none. Default 2.

waive.description: The hard rules of the melody stage that are not held (R-672): a waived rule neither refuses a candidate nor scores it. Empty by default.

reverse.description: The soft rule groups whose score counts what a candidate breaks in place of what it holds (R-672), so a setting can ask for the opposite. Empty by default.

motif.description: The settings of the segments motive generator (docs/preferences.md).

bars.description: Whole-number weights 0 to 20; the sum of the entries is above 0.

pickup_one_in.description: A pickup is drawn one time in this many; 0 never draws one.

shapes_one_bar.description: Whole-number weights 0 to 20; the sum of the entries is above 0.

shapes_two_bars.description: Whole-number weights 0 to 20; the sum of the entries is above 0.

plans_two.description: Whole-number weights 0 to 20; the sum of the entries is above 0.

plans_three.description: Whole-number weights 0 to 20; the sum of the entries is above 0.

features.description: Whole-number weights 0 to 20; the sum of the entries is above 0.

rung_moves.description: Whole-number weights 0 to 20; the sum of the entries is above 0.

decorations.description: Whole-number weights 0 to 20; the sum of the entries is above 0.

durations.description: Whole-number weights 0 to 20; the sum of the entries is above 0.

accented_one_in.description: An eligible note becomes an accented non-chord tone one time in this many; 0 never. Off by default.

accented_types.description: Whole-number weights 0 to 20; the sum of the entries is above 0. Which accented non-chord tone is placed.

avoid_repeats.description: No repeated note: decorations try the other kinds before a chord tone, and a repeat of a pitch is refused. Off by default.

leaps_per_motif.description: The most intervals of 5 semitones or more in a motive; 11 never rejects.

leap_recovery.description: A leap is followed by a move of 1 or 2 semitones the other way. Off by default.

pickup_from_accent.description: A pickup is one chord tone below segment a's first note and no longer than it; a motive that opens with an implied upbeat but has no pickup is refused. Off by default.

contrast_fidelity_min.description: n/d with 0 <= n <= d and d from 1 to 1000. The least recognizability of a contrasting segment against segment a; 0/1 never rejects.

long_on_weak.description: The two-beat note is this much more likely on a weak beat (its weight times 1 plus this); 0 changes nothing.

final_long.description: The last note of the last segment is longer than every other note in it. Off by default.

compound_beats.description: In 6/8, 9/8 and 12/8 the beat is the dotted quarter: cells are tiled in beats of three eighths. No effect in any other meter. Off by default.

endings.description: Whole-number weights 0 to 20; the sum of the entries is above 0. How the last segment ends: free (as drawn), closed, open or lead_in. Free by default.

long_nct_one_in.description: A segment gets a long non-chord tone (on a beat, a beat or longer, resolving to the next note) one time in this many; 0 never. Off by default.

long_nct_types.description: Whole-number weights 0 to 20; the sum of the entries is above 0. Which long non-chord tone is placed.

long_nct_intervals.description: Whole-number weights 0 to 20; the sum of the entries is above 0. The tone's interval above the chord root.

long_nct_beats.description: Whole-number weights 0 to 20; the sum of the entries is above 0. Where the tone sits: the downbeat, the middle of the bar, another beat.

long_nct_lengths.description: Whole-number weights 0 to 20; the sum of the entries is above 0. How long the tone is: a beat, a dotted beat, two beats or more.

syncopation_one_in.description: A cell, and a segment boundary, gets a syncopation one time in this many; 0 never. Simple meters only, never on the motif's last note. Off by default.

syncopation_types.description: Whole-number weights 0 to 20; the sum of the entries is above 0. Which figure: an off-beat note held across the beat, a tie across the beat, a tie across the barline, or an anticipation of a new chord.

syncopation_levels.description: Whole-number weights 0 to 20; the sum of the entries is above 0. At which level: the short note a half beat (eighth) or a quarter beat (sixteenth).

skips_per_motif.description: The most skips (intervals of 3 or 4 semitones) in a motif; 11 never rejects, the default.

color_note.description: In a modal key, the first this many tries of a setup keep a motif only when a note on a beat is one of the mode's characteristic steps (R-732). 0 asks for none; major and minor keys have none. Default 4.

color_chords.description: n/d with 0 <= n <= d and d from 1 to 16. How often a chord of the motif's plan takes a color type of harmony.color.types that fits it (a major triad of the key; add9, add6, six-nine, the ninths; R-727). 0/1 draws none, the default.

plan.description: A given chord plan: Roman numerals I to VII in any case, an optional o or degree sign or color suffix (add9, add6, 69, 9, maj9: the chord must be a major triad of the key), an optional place @bar or @bar:beat (bar 1 or 2, beat 1 to 12). Either no chord has a place (at most 3 chords) or every chord after the first has one, rising. Absent by default: the plan is drawn.

development.description: The settings of the theme's development (docs/preferences.md).

presentation.description: n/d with 0 <= n <= d and d from 1 to 1000.

continuation.description: n/d with 0 <= n <= d and d from 1 to 1000.

cadential.description: n/d with 0 <= n <= d and d from 1 to 1000.

presentation.description: n/d with 0 <= n <= d and d from 1 to 1000.

continuation.description: n/d with 0 <= n <= d and d from 1 to 1000.

cadential.description: n/d with 0 <= n <= d and d from 1 to 1000.

presentation.description: n/d with 0 <= n <= d and d from 1 to 1000.

continuation.description: n/d with 0 <= n <= d and d from 1 to 1000.

cadential.description: n/d with 0 <= n <= d and d from 1 to 1000.

continuation.description: How a sentence's continuation accelerates (docs/grow-continuation.md). Every member is off by default.

every_segment.description: Both fragments are drawn from every segment of the motif, never both from the same one.

fragment_lengths.description: Whole-number weights 0 to 20; the sum of the entries is above 0. A fragment is its whole segment, half a bar of it, or a beat of it. Segment alone by default.

diminish.description: A fragment that is a whole segment is that segment in diminution 1:2.

liquidate.description: Fragment 2 is liquidated, and the cadential idea liquidates a step further.

faster_harmony.description: An 8-bar sentence's continuation changes chord every cell and cadences on the cadential idea.

basic_as_written.description: A motif as long as the basic idea is the basic idea as written, over its own chords. Off by default.

contrast.description: How a theme's contrasting ideas contrast: a similar or a distant rhythm, or new material. All 0 reads as similar 1.

functions.description: Themes whose ideas follow their formal function (R-710 to R-712). Every member is off by default.

harmony.description: Each idea of an antecedent and of an ending takes its harmony from its formal function.

surface.description: The fragments of a continuation are drawn from the busiest segment and another.

contrast.description: A contrasting idea is drawn to meet its function's contrast target in rhythm, contour, register and density.

candidates.description: How a set of random motives is chosen (R-673). Off by default.

variety.description: How much a motive is chosen for being unlike the ones before it. 0 leaves the draw as it was.

pool.description: How many candidates are drawn for each motive that is chosen among. Default 4.

critic.description: The critic (R-722): how a candidate is judged in her words, and whether a theme is chosen among candidates by it. Off by default.

rank.description: Choose the theme among several candidates by the critic's score. Default false.

candidates.description: How many candidates are made for each theme kept. Default 4.

keep_rejected.description: How many rejected candidates a run reports. Default 8.

reverse.description: Evaluators whose penalty counts for a candidate instead of against it.

weights.description: The weight of each evaluator, 0 to 20.

rhythmic_monotony.description: Bars that keep one rhythm, run after run. Weight 0 to 20; default 1.

contrast_distance.description: A contrasting idea too close to the basic idea in rhythm and contour, or too far in register. Weight 0 to 20; default 1.

leap_load.description: Skips and leaps, a third counting half a leap. Weight 0 to 20; default 1.

open_ending.description: A last note no longer than the line's mean note. Weight 0 to 20; default 1.

stray_syncopation.description: A syncopation that never comes back. Weight 0 to 20; default 1.

one_rhythm.description: Candidates of one set that open with one rhythm. Weight 0 to 20; default 1.

wide_range.description: A range wider than a tenth. Weight 0 to 20; default 1.

register_shift.description: A shift of register of more than a fifth from one bar to the next. Weight 0 to 20; default 1.

half_notes.description: Half notes one after another. Weight 0 to 20; default 1.

harmony.description: The settings of the phrase model's chords (docs/preferences.md).

mixture.description: Modal mixture (R-729): how often a predominant chord of the phrase model is borrowed from another mode. Off by default.

share.description: The chance a predominant chord is borrowed, a ratio n/d from 0/1 to 1/1 (d up to 16). Default 0/1: nothing is borrowed.

from.description: The relation words, in order, whose modes a chord is borrowed from: the first whose triad on the degree differs from the key's and is not avoided. Default parallel, one step darker, one step brighter.

color.description: Color chords (R-727): how often a chord of the phrase model sounds the members of a chord type (an added ninth, a six-nine, a ninth chord, a quartal chord) while every check reads the basic chord. Off by default.

share.description: The chance a chord gets a color type, a ratio n/d from 0/1 to 1/1 (d up to 16). Default 0/1: no chord is colored.

types.description: The K2 chord type ids a color type is drawn from, among those that fit the chord. Default the ten persichetti types.

blueprint.description: The settings of the blueprint generator (docs/preferences-blueprint.md, R-750).

sounds.description: How often the generator draws a sound against none, and the weight of a rhythm cell holding a long note off the downbeat (R-750). Weights 0 to 20.

ninth_downbeat.description: A ninth over the chord on a bar's downbeat. Default 3.

sus4_dominant.description: A suspended fourth before the dominant chord. Default 2.

appoggiatura.description: An appoggiatura on a bar's downbeat. Default 3.

major_seventh.description: A major seventh on the longest note of a tonic or subdominant bar. Default 1.

leading_tone.description: The leading tone into the final tonic. Default 2.

long_weak.description: The extra weight of a rhythm cell holding a note of a beat or longer off the downbeat. Default 2.

jobs.description: The weight of each rhythm job a unit of an idea may take, per formal function (R-750).

basic.description: The basic idea's second bar (the motif strategy blueprint reads it). Defaults running 2, long 3, syncopated 1, variant 2, contrast 1.

running.description: The weight of the job running. Weight 0 to 20.

long.description: The weight of the job long. Weight 0 to 20.

syncopated.description: The weight of the job syncopated. Weight 0 to 20.

variant.description: The weight of the job variant. Weight 0 to 20.

contrast.description: The weight of the job contrast. Weight 0 to 20.

fragment.description: The sentence's first fragment. Defaults running 3, long 0, syncopated 2, variant 1, contrast 1.

running.description: The weight of the job running. Weight 0 to 20.

long.description: The weight of the job long. Weight 0 to 20.

syncopated.description: The weight of the job syncopated. Weight 0 to 20.

variant.description: The weight of the job variant. Weight 0 to 20.

contrast.description: The weight of the job contrast. Weight 0 to 20.

contrasting.description: The contrasting idea of a period and its consequent. Defaults running 1, long 1, syncopated 1, variant 0, contrast 3.

running.description: The weight of the job running. Weight 0 to 20.

long.description: The weight of the job long. Weight 0 to 20.

syncopated.description: The weight of the job syncopated. Weight 0 to 20.

variant.description: The weight of the job variant. Weight 0 to 20.

contrast.description: The weight of the job contrast. Weight 0 to 20.

cadential.description: The sentence's cadential idea's first bar. Defaults running 2, long 2, syncopated 1, variant 1, contrast 0.

running.description: The weight of the job running. Weight 0 to 20.

long.description: The weight of the job long. Weight 0 to 20.

syncopated.description: The weight of the job syncopated. Weight 0 to 20.

variant.description: The weight of the job variant. Weight 0 to 20.

contrast.description: The weight of the job contrast. Weight 0 to 20.

climax.description: The weight of the climax in bar 5 (m6) and bar 6 (m7) of a sentence (R-750). Weights 0 to 20; both 0 takes the last.

range.description: The semitones the melody spans below the climax. 12 to 24; default 16.

candidates.description: The themes drawn for one request, of which the critic keeps one. 1 to 8; default 3.
